housing-numbers.notes: Plan states target to exceed 20,685 homes over plan period. London Plan sets annual target of 985 homes per year. Housing trajectory shows mix of deliverable sites (years 1-5) and developable sites (years 6-15). Windfall allowance of 2,500 homes each for years 6-10 and 11-15 totaling 5,000. Historically 80%+ of delivery has been windfall. Document mentions Site Allocations DPD will provide detailed site capacities.
